Problem Statement:
Consider the following series1,1,2,3,4,9,8,27,16,81,32,243,64,729,128,2187...This series is a mixture of 2 series - all the odd terms in this series form a geometric series and all the even terms form yet anothergeometric seriesWrite a program to findnd the Nth term in this series. 
Input Description:
You can assume that N will not exceed 30 
Output Description:
Print the Nth term 
Explanation:
For example , if N=16, then the 16th term in this series is 2187. so only the value 2187 should be printed to STDOUT 
Sample Input:
16 
Sample Output:
2187
